comment: The channel inputs and outputs carry whatever is patched to them, audio or control voltage, so they are left without a family. The hardware reaches the selection scope, sequencing mode, interpolation curve, VCA response, preset save and load, copy and paste, randomisation and LED brightness through long presses and combinations of SEL, AMP, VAR and KEY; in the plugin these are menu items, and the 12 factory presets are one of them. The installed build offers three selection scopes, single, columns and all, where the hardware manual also lists rows. Firmware update, VCA calibration and LED brightness have no counterpart here.
